Label (A-B): PCoCo - EIC Project Primary Coordinator contact for
Label (B-A): PCoCo - EIC Project Primary Coordinator contact is
Current description: The Primary Coordinator Contact is for each project the main contact between the consortium and the EU for a particular project/contract
Proposed description: The Primary Coordinator Contact (PCoCo) is the main contact between the consortium and the EU for a particular project/contract.

Label (A-B): CoCo - EIC Project Coordinator Contact for
Label (B-A): CoCo - EIC Project Coordinator Contact is
Current description: Coordinator Contact (CoCo) are added by the PCoCo for the project/contract (unlimited number possible)
Proposed description: Coordinator Contact (CoCo), added by the PCoCo for the project/contract (unlimited number possible).

Label (A-B): PaCo - EIC Project Participant Contact for
Label (B-A): PaCo - EIC Project Participant Contact is
Current description: The Participant Contact (PaCo) is a representative of an organisation in the consortium that is not the coordinating organisation. An organisation can have an unlimited number of PaCos per project.
Proposed description: Participant Contact (PaCo): representative of a consortium organisation that is not the coordinating organisation. Unlimited number per project.

Label (A-B): LEAR - EIC Organisation Legal Entity Appointed Representative for
Label (B-A): LEAR - EIC Organisation Legal Entity Appointed Representative is
Current description: The LEAR (Organisation Legal Entity Appointed Representative) is the formally nominated main responsible for an organisation use of the Funding and Tender Portal and thus bears the final responsibility for all the organisation actions.
Proposed description: Legal Entity Appointed Representative (LEAR): formally nominated main responsible for the organisation's use of the Funding & Tenders Portal.

Machine name (A-B / B-A): EIC Project member of / EIC Project member is
Current description: Is part of an EIC project with another role than PCoCo, CoCo or PaCo
Proposed description: Part of an EIC project with a role other than PCoCo, CoCo or PaCo.

Machine name (A-B / B-A): Main contact for / Main contact is
Current description: The main contact for the organisation regarding EIC Business Acceleration Services (BAS). Usually communicated by the beneficiary in Section 2 of the EU-Survey onboarding form, but can also be added manually. Links the primary contact person to the beneficiary organisation; the contact's declared role is stored on the Individual's job title.
Proposed description: The main contact for the organisation regarding EIC Business Acceleration Services (BAS). Usually communicated by the beneficiary in Section 2 of the EU-Survey onboarding form, but can also be added manually. Links the primary contact person to the beneficiary organisation; the contact's declared role is stored on the Individual's job title.
Last reviewed: Label renamed from 'Main contact'; machine name unchanged

Current description: An additional contact for the organisation regarding EIC Business Acceleration Services (BAS). Usually communicated by the beneficiary in the EU-Survey onboarding form (which allows up to three additional contacts, contacts 2 to 4, beyond the main contact), but can also be added manually. Links a contact person to the beneficiary organisation; the contact's declared role is stored on the Individual's job title.
Proposed description: An additional contact for the organisation regarding EIC Business Acceleration Services (BAS). Usually communicated by the beneficiary in the EU-Survey onboarding form (which allows up to three additional contacts, contacts 2 to 4, beyond the main contact), but can also be added manually. Links a contact person to the beneficiary organisation; the contact's declared role is stored on the Individual's job title.
Last reviewed: Label renamed from 'Contact'; machine name unchanged

Current description: Key Account Manager (KAM) responsible for the organisation.
Proposed description: Key Account Manager (KAM) responsible for the organisation. On an EIC Awardee Onboarding case the KAM is the case manager (manager role EIC_KAM_Is). The onboarding case import finds the KAM by email (kam_email) and creates this relationship scoped to that case.
Links an Investor Representative individual to their Investor organisation.

Planned internal EIC role: the Project Officer responsible for a beneficiary/project. Not yet implemented - to be added as a new relationship type analogous to KAM. See import-sync-eic-awardees spec Requirement 14.

Planned internal EIC role: the Programme Manager responsible for a beneficiary/programme. Not yet implemented - to be added as a new relationship type analogous to KAM. See import-sync-eic-awardees spec Requirement 14.

Current description: The founder of the organisation. Communicated by the beneficiary in the EIC VM Fundraising Assessment EU-Survey (Founder's Primary Contact), and used as a case role on the VentureMatch Service Request case (client-facing direction: Founder is).
Proposed description: The founder of the organisation. Communicated by the beneficiary in the EIC VM Fundraising Assessment EU-Survey (Founder's Primary Contact), and used as a case role on the VentureMatch Service Request case (client-facing direction: Founder is).

Machine name (A-B / B-A): Investment Adviser for / Investment Adviser is
Current description: The VentureMatch investment adviser responsible for the beneficiary organisation. On a VentureMatch Service Request case the adviser (Investment Adviser is) is the case manager, replacing the generic Case Coordinator. Advisers are members of the EIC VentureMatch access-control group. Only the client-facing 'Investment Adviser is' direction is used as the case role.
Proposed description: The VentureMatch investment adviser responsible for the beneficiary organisation. On a VentureMatch Service Request case the adviser (Investment Adviser is) is the case manager, replacing the generic Case Coordinator. Advisers are members of the EIC VentureMatch access-control group. Only the client-facing 'Investment Adviser is' direction is used as the case role.
